notes: nll_threshold_candidate will be frozen at Week 2 based on the baseline NLL distribution on the validation partition.
The threshold must not be tuned on or informed by the final test partition.
The primary tail_retention metric (ratio-based) requires a reference mode-score snapshot from the baseline model at generation 0.
The nll_gap metric requires no reference — it compares tail vs common NLL on the same checkpoint.
Both metrics are independent of the policy undercoverage_score selection signal.
The frozen primary metric and threshold will be recorded here and in PREREGISTRATION.md before primary outcomes are opened.
